Completing this proof would require a stronger property: for any polycommunication auction rule, there exists some case where the auction rule gets welfare ℓ, but the optimal total welfare is in fact x + 2(ℓ − 1). 14 This specific value of x arises from assuming x = ρℓ for some ρ ∈ (0, 1), then making the two terms in the above maximum equal to each other while ignoring lower-order factors.
